mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances during easing periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 2.5% triggers expectations of higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses 2.5, or IC > 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) coupled with falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a positive feedback loop, increasing equity demand and compressing discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS move in expected directions, or IC < 0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) signal over-optimism in the labor market, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative in late-cycle periods, or IC > 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) alongside falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) enhances production capacity and lowers discount rates, boosting equity demand and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive when both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS move in expected directions, or IC < 0.03 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand measured by HOUST exceeding 1000 units signals robust consumer spending, driving equity demand and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when HOUST crosses 1000, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 5% coupled with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) signal labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive in post-shock periods, or IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in labor demand (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates a robust labor market environment, driving equity demand and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in expected directions, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.
